versions.changelog:
Self-Improving Agent (Proactive Self-Reflection) 1.2.10 introduces sharper proactive reflection and improved memory listing:

- Now lists relevant memory before any non-trivial work, clearly highlighting proactive self-reflection.
- Expanded documentation on triggers, tiered storage, and memory operations.
- Clear logging format and rules for corrections and self-learning.
- Transparent, user-controllable memory management with promotion/demotion rules and namespacing.
- Security and privacy boundaries reinforced; no third-party or sensitive data stored.
